status: PLACEHOLDER - pending health center / medical validator approval. Do not rely on these for real patient care.
gate_note: Below this top probability the result carries a 'Low model confidence' flag on the dashboard. Display only: no retake, no change to tier, queue or transmission order.
tie_break_note: Order inside the same tier for the staff queue. 'probability' (default) = higher probability of the tier first, with bounded waiting: a patient can be passed by at most max_bypass newer patients of the same tier, then goes next (bounded-waiting principle, Silberschatz et al. 2018). max_bypass = 2 is a design choice: the smallest limit that still lets the probability order work, and two extra consultations (about 20 min) stay within the 30-min ATS limit for urgent patients. 'wait' = oldest first. The outbox always sends highest tier first, then oldest first (edge_db.claim_next).
critical_limits_source: Placeholder values. Default source: the most extreme band of each vital in NEWS2, Royal College of Physicians 2017. Exception: high blood pressure follows the 2024 Philippine Clinical Practice Guideline on Acute Severe Blood Pressure Elevation (systolic >=180 or diastolic >=120), because the training data has no systolic above 146 so the model cannot judge high BP. NOT yet confirmed by the barangay health center. A reading AT a limit counts as critical.
temperature_high_note: NEWS2 scores temperature of 39.1 or higher as 2, not 3, so it has no red-score high limit. 39.1 is kept as a placeholder until the health center decides.
